decks.notes: The main concept of this Izzet Control deck is to build up card advantage and control the game through a combination of counter spells, removal, and card draw. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while setting up for powerful late-game plays such as casting Jeskai Revelation or utilizing Thor, God of Thunder. By efficiently managing resources and utilizing card advantage engines like Accumulate Wisdom and Tablet of Discovery, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through a combination of spells and powerful creatures.

The main strategy of this Azorius Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing a mix of control elements like Spell Snare and Erode, along with aggressive threats like Aang, Swift Savior and Voice of Victory, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent from the beginning of the game. With a solid mana base and a well-balanced curve, this deck can apply constant pressure while also maintaining a strong defensive position against opposing threats.

This deck focuses on quickly playing multiple low-cost spells and creatures to pressure the opponent, while also having some control elements with counterspells and bounce effects. The goal is to maintain board presence and efficiently deal damage to the opponent while disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of cards like Burst Lightning and Sleight of Hand allows the deck to quickly burn out the opponent or draw into more threats. The deck aims to be aggressive and disruptive, putting the opponent on the back foot and forcing them to react to the relentless pressure.

Utilize a combination of graveyard recursion and powerful creatures to overwhelm your opponent. Fill your graveyard with cards using discard spells like Duress and Deceit, then bring back powerful threats like Superior Spider-Man with cards like Requiting Hex and Winternight Stories. Use control elements such as Deadly Cover-Up and Doomsday Excruciator to disrupt your opponent's game plan. Utilize the various lands like Gloomlake Verge and Undercity Sewers to fix your mana base and generate extra value. Strategically time your plays to maximize your advantage and outpace your opponent.

Utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, card draw, and efficient creatures, the deck aims to control the game by disrupting the opponent's game plan while advancing its own win condition. By efficiently managing resources and staying ahead on board presence, the deck can outvalue opponents and dictate the pace of the game. The inclusion of versatile cards like Prismari Charm and Burst Lightning allows for flexibility in dealing with various threats, while the inclusion of efficient creatures like Stormchaser's Talent and Eddymurk Crab provides pressure and potential win conditions.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent through aggressive creatures and efficient spells. By utilizing cards like Burst Lightning and Stormchaser's Talent, the deck aims to control the board while dealing direct damage to the opponent. Eddymurk Crab and Hydro-Man, Fluid Felon provide additional threats, while cards like Opt and Sleight of Hand help ensure a consistent flow of resources. With a mix of creature-based aggression and spell-based control, this UR Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent, using a combination of low-cost spells and creatures. The deck focuses on efficiently casting spells to trigger abilities such as prowess and prowess-like effects for additional damage. The inclusion of disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Secret Identity helps control the game, while cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Eddymurk Crab provide consistent damage output. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggression and control.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while utilizing ramp and evasion tactics. The deck focuses on early aggression with cards like Ba Sing Se, Badgermole Cub, Sazh's Chocobo, and Llanowar Elves to get ahead on board presence. Earthbender Ascension and Mightform Harmonizer provide power boosts to the creatures, while Sapling Nursery and Defend the Rider help protect them. The inclusion of Icetill Explorer and Escape Tunnel adds evasion and flexibility to push through damage. Overall, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board and maintain pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through card advantage, removal spells, and card draw. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gaining incremental value from its spells. It utilizes a mix of burn spells, counterspells, and card draw to outvalue the opponent and maintain board control. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers, like Thor, God of Thunder, to generate additional advantage. By efficiently managing resources and reacting to threats, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through attrition.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, board wipes, and card draw. It utilizes a variety of lands to ensure mana consistency and has access to a wide range of card types to handle different threats. By managing the opponent's board state and maintaining card advantage, the player aims to outlast their opponent and eventually win through powerful spells and card advantage engines. The deck is designed to disrupt the opponent's strategy and gain incremental advantage over time, ultimately leading to victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through various spells and abilities, using a combination of counterspells, board wipes, and card advantage to outmaneuver the opponent. It utilizes a mix of different lands and mana sources to ensure consistency in casting its wide range of spells. The main win condition is to establish board control and card advantage, gradually wearing down the opponent's resources until they can secure a victory through card draw or a powerful finisher like North Wind Avatar or Jeskai Revelation.

This Naya Aggro deck focuses on fast aggressive plays and overwhelming opponents with a wide board presence. It includes efficient creatures and spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent, while also providing ways to protect your own creatures and maintain momentum. The deck aims to continuously pressure the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. By utilizing a mix of creatures with low casting costs and powerful combat tricks, this deck looks to overwhelm opponents and secure victories through constant aggression.

The main focus of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to swarm the board with aggressive creatures and use combat tricks to protect them and deal damage quickly. The deck includes several efficient creatures like Leatherhead, Swamp Stalker and Pawpatch Recruit, along with removal spells like Erode and Seam Rip to clear the opponent's blockers. Multiversal Passage and Abandoned Air Temple help ramp up mana for big threats like Surrak, Elusive Hunter and Brightglass Gearhulk. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful creature-based strategy.

This deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells and card advantage. By using powerful cards like Fire Magic and Combustion Technique, the player can efficiently deal with opposing threats. The deck also includes card draw and filtering effects such as Accumulate Wisdom and Tablet of Discovery to ensure a steady stream of resources. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful creatures like Thor, God of Thunder and Gran-Gran provides a strong win condition. Overall, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a slow and methodical manner.

The main concept of this Izzet Control deck is to maintain board control by utilizing counter spells, removal spells, and efficient creatures. The deck focuses on tempo plays, card advantage, and disruption to outvalue the opponent. It aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while advancing its own win conditions through efficient card draw, burn spells, and versatile threats. The deck also includes cards that can bounce or tap down opponent's creatures, providing additional ways to control the battlefield and maintain a winning position.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells in order to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck focuses on utilizing spells like Burst Lightning and Flow State, along with creatures like Slickshot Show-Off and Eddymurk Crab, to keep up the pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Boomerang Basics and Riverpyre Verge to control the board and maintain tempo. Overall, the deck aims to be fast-paced and relentless in its pursuit of victory.
